featured_reviews.review_text: Nazneen has been incredible in guiding me toward both personal and professional growth. featured_reviews.name: Meraj Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I heard about In Touch Therapy through a
friend. And I made no reservations before
contacting Nazneen, I had the most sought
after discussion with her, the most important
thing to look for in your therapist or councellor
is not just reassuring words but also truth
delivered in the softest way possible, and
Nazneen did just that. First, the session was
booked ASAP, she's very responsive and
professional since she takes the wellbeing of
her clients seriously. Second, she's genuine

featured_reviews.name: Aditya Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
Working with Nazneen has been nothing short of life-changing. She’s like a human mirror—kind, patient, but unafraid to show me the reflection I’ve been avoiding for years. Her insights are spot on, and her practical advice, like journaling and setting goals, feels less like homework and more like a personal cheat code for life. She’s helped me untangle my insecurities and even encouraged me to be more selfish, skill I didn’t know I needed until now. Honestly, she’s so good I’m starting to wonder if she can read minds (Real ID se aao Mr Charles Xavier). 10/10 would recommend, unless you’re my inner critic—it’s not having a good time!
Tldr: She is Dr Wong, but just dont be Rick or Beth.

featured_reviews.name: Ashwin Iyer
featured_reviews.review_text: Nazneen Sheikh is my therapist and the sessions are always so enlightening and helpful. I always leave the meet with a broad smile on my face, feeling much lighter and much more confident about myself and my life. She helps build a safe and healthy space to talk about your feelings, vent out any frustration and get some really useful, practical wisdom. It is a truly positive and wonderful experience

featured_reviews.name: poornima ujwal
featured_reviews.review_text: The therapists at In touch are truly wonderful. Not only do they provide quality care, their vast approach and clarity will be helpful to you irrespective of the issues and concerns. Even if you're someone who's not sure what the problem is, I recommend you go ahead with a session and it will give you results . Nazneen especially has a very gentle yet firm approach to her clients. She has a very good grasp of her subject and will be a good fit for individuals who are looking for answers about their mental health.

featured_reviews.name: Ozair Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: After countless thoughts of visiting a therapist, I finally decided to go for one just so that I can be sane. I reached out to Nazneen and was reluctant to open up at first, but she made the whole process so easy for me and soon I just get involved a 100%. She has really good understanding of the field and I appreciate her empathy and guidance during our sessions. I feel so much more aware about myself now and working towards peace.

featured_reviews.name: Anita Prasad
featured_reviews.review_text: Nazneen is the best therapist I have met. She makes it really easy and comfortable to share any issue/details with her and her solutions have really helped me a lot. I am really thankful that I came across her!

featured_reviews.name: Siddhant Rai
featured_reviews.review_text: Nazneen truly justifies the meaning of her name, she indeed is a beautiful woman inside-out. I was in my gloomiest days when I started my therapy with her, I still very clearly remember the way she welcomed me with a smile, which made it very easy for me to talk about my problems, traumas and pathetic experiences with her. I’ve not only understood the vitality of self love but have actually started loving myself. My defence mechanism has gotten stronger, I’ve recovered from severe High Functioning Depression and am now able to discover new things about myself. Earlier, all of this was an unachievable goal for me and I’d like thanking Nazneen for all that she has done, I want you guys to know that she created a safe space for me by being non-judgemental, polite, respectful and a good listener. She has made me feel valued and I just want her to keep flying high on the wings of success❤️.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Dr. Mansi works exceptionally well in helping you identify where you are mentally and emotionally standing. She gently brings awareness to hidden thought patterns and helps you recognize the difference between reality and the stories your subconscious mind has been holding onto. If someone is looking for a real shift in mindset, emotional healing, or wants to break old belief systems but has no clue where to begin, I would highly recommend her. A very compassionate, aware, and transformative therapist.

featured_reviews.name: Jitesh Loke
featured_reviews.review_text:
There was a time when I was completely broken—emotionally shattered and  exhausted by life’s untoward incidents, sinking into severe depression as anger became my only language, hurt by the people I trusted the most. In that chaos, Kshipra was my calm. She didn’t rush to fix me. She didn't judge my anger or silence. Instead, she gently held space for my pain, with her unique and thoughtful way of making me speak, sometimes without even realising i opened up to her as she helped me confront my emotions. Her therapy sessions were simple, yet very effective. Knowing how stubborn, difficult, and arrogant I can be, she handled me with immense patience, strength, and grace as she put back that smile in my life. What felt impossible back then, she helped me make it real again. Having known Kshipra for the last four years, I can say this with absolute certainty: if you are battling anxiety, depression, emotional numbness, or feel lost and low in life—please visit her and she will work her way through your situations & circumstances.
I never said this back then, but  Thank you Kshipra, for standing by me when I was devastated, lifeless, and broken. You didn’t just help me heal—you helped me find myself again. May you continue to spread the same light and heal every soul that walks into your space.

I want to share my heartfelt experience with Dr. Ketan Parmar.
My mother had been unwell for several years, and it was an incredibly difficult phase for our entire family. We struggled to understand what was happening to her, and at times, it felt like we were slowly losing her. There was confusion, emotional pain, and a constant sense of helplessness.
When I finally consulted Dr. Ketan Parmar, everything began to change. He carefully evaluated my mother and diagnosed her with schizophrenia, something we hadn’t been able to properly identify before. What truly stood out was not just his expertise, but the patience, empathy, and reassurance he provided throughout the process.
With the right treatment and guidance from him, we started noticing changes. Gradually, my mother began to come back to herself. The transformation wasn’t just medical it felt like we were getting her back, piece by piece.
Today, I can genuinely say that my mother is back to life. There was a time I believed I had lost her forever, but thanks to Dr. Parmar’s treatment and care, I got my mother back. I will always be grateful for what he has done for our family.

featured_reviews.review_text:
If you take your car to a mechanic, chances are he or she is going to find something to fix. If all you have in your tool belt is a hammer, every problem is a nail.

And my point is? Finding a great therapist for your child when he (or she) is struggling can bring with it some serious risks: labels that stick to your child like glue; stigma among his peers; culturally insensitive recommendations; parent-blaming lectures; even a referral for medication or in-patient treatment when simpler, less intrusive solution are possible.

Just walking into the office of a mental health professional like Zarna Badheka can make the child feel different. She does her work the best
